response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine tooling and developer-experience interests, but the core requirements of this role — deep Java/Kotlin expertise, JVM internals, and hands-on Spring ecosystem experience — are essentially absent from the resume. Java appears only peripherally (robotic arms work, skills list), Kotlin and Spring not at all, and his primary strengths lie in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. His IDE experience (LabWindows/CVI) is brief, dated, and C/C++-based, making him a poor fit for an enterprise JVM IDE role despite an otherwise solid engineering background.
strengths: Prior hands-on IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI components)
Strong track record building developer tooling, test frameworks, and low-latency systems
Demonstrated open-source contributions, teaching, and craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: No demonstrable Kotlin or Spring/enterprise-Java framework experience
Java exposure is minimal, dated, and secondary to DLang/TypeScript work
IDE-internals experience is brief (~6 months) and over a decade old

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and testing framework background
Dated and limited IDE internals experience
